To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present a new framework for video frame interpolation, DeepLTE, that is based on a deep auto encoding model and is capable of generating new frames from multiple given frames.

we propose a new framework for video frame interpolation that is able to generate high quality frames from a few input frames, and is also able to interpolate an arbitrary number of output frames, without the need of a training phase.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of video frame interpolation.

the following three points: (i) we propose a generative video frame interpolation framework which can be used instantly without any training, and is able of generating an arbitrary number of new frames; (ii) we demonstrate that our model outperforms existing methods in terms of perceptual quality; (iii) our model is able to generate sharp motion and is able to preserve fine details.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
DeepLTE achieves the highest perceptual quality with the lowest computational cost.
, DeepLTE can be used instantly and can be applied to any video without the need of training or fine tuning, and can generate frames with sharp motion and high perceptual quality.
DeepLTE achieves the state of the art in video frame synthesis in terms of both quantitative and perceptual qualities, and is the most general framework that can be applied to any video sequence.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose an efficient deep learning framework that is able to generate sharp and natural looking frames in a plug and Play and unsupervised way.
DeepLTE provides a new way to tackle frame interpolation problem by using a plug and play deep learning framework.
DeepLTE is the first plug and play generative model for video interpolation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, with a proper design of constraints, deep learning models can be trained to work instantly, and can be deployed in real time applications.
, in the context of video frame interpolation, the generalization ability of a model can be more important than its pixel to pixel performance.
, in the era of big data and powerful computing, we can still benefit from the generalization ability and the interpretability of simple models.
